# Trident Software Sàrl

> Operational software and AI agents from Sion, Valais, Switzerland. We build the systems companies run their daily work on, and the AI layer that removes the repetitive part of it.

## About

Trident Software Sàrl is a Swiss company in Sion, Valais (CHE-185.076.733), hosted at the HES-SO Valais-Wallis School of Engineering, with a representative office at Campus Biotech, Geneva. It also owns a product, 8Move, a logistics platform in production with paying customers.

## Services

- AI agents & LLM automation — AI sales agents, assistants and document processing
- Logistics & operations platforms — order intake, dispatch, field apps, billing
- IoT & connected products — firmware, devices and the software around them
- Custom business systems — web and mobile software built around the client's process
- CTO as a Service — technical leadership for startups and scale-ups

## Industries

Automotive, Blockchain, Catering, DIY, Education and training providers, Fashion & Luxury, Fintech, FMCG & Consumer Goods, Games, Clinics, dental and veterinary practices, Hospitality and restaurants, Logistics & Supply Chain, Manufacturing, Professional services and trades, Real estate and property management, E-commerce and D2C, SaaS, Social Media, Sport & Activities, Startups and scale-ups, Tourism, Trade, wholesale and building materials.

- Headquarters: Rue de l'Industrie 23, 1950 Sion, Switzerland
